jobs.full_reason: DataHub's iceberg source lists every table the lakehouse catalog holds and reads each one's current metadata (names, columns, types, snapshot); it reads no data file. Stateful ingestion then writes only the aspects that changed and removes the tables that are gone, so the catalog side is partial while the read is whole.
jobs.full_cost: about 150 tables' metadata JSON through the catalog's read-only token (no rows, no data file); first run estimated below and measured from its journal.
jobs.full_tracked_by: removed with DataHub when Airflow is retired (docs/designs/data-catalog-datahub-vs-dagster.md, option C, coordinator decision 2026-11-19)
jobs.description: Read the lakehouse catalog's tables (names, columns, types, current snapshot) into the data catalog every day, as root ADR-0117 §3 said and nothing did since 2026-10-01 (infra/datahub/recipes/lakehouse-iceberg.yml).

first_run.estimated_from: about 150 tables, one catalog loadTable and one metadata JSON read each (sub-second each from ai-server to the R2 catalog, as the publisher's snapshot reads measure), plus the ingestion image's start: a few minutes, inside the 30-minute limit. The ingestion container is capped at 1 GiB at its run site (scripts/deploy/datahub-runtime.sh).

expected_outcome.no_change_bound_reason: An operation on the catalog, not a data producer: it writes no lakehouse table, so a finished run prints `foundation-job-outcome unchanged` (scripts/deploy/datahub-runtime.sh). That it keeps finishing is the done bound.

jobs.full_reason: DataHub's odcs source reads every contract file of the release (contracts/data, about 143); stateful ingestion writes only what changed and removes contracts that are gone.
jobs.full_cost: about 143 local YAML files; no network read but GMS. Measured 2026-10-18 on ai-server: 124 MiB peak for 45 contracts (scripts/deploy/datahub-runtime.sh).
jobs.full_tracked_by: removed with DataHub when Airflow is retired (docs/designs/data-catalog-datahub-vs-dagster.md, option C, coordinator decision 2026-11-19)
jobs.description: Register the release's data contracts (datasets, owners, one assertion per rule) in the data catalog every day, as root ADR-0117 §3 said and nothing did since 2026-10-01 (infra/datahub/recipes/data-contracts.yml).

first_run.estimated_from: 143 local contract files and their assertions sent to GMS; the 2026-10-01 runs by hand finished within minutes. The ingestion container is capped at 1 GiB at its run site (scripts/deploy/datahub-runtime.sh).

expected_outcome.no_change_bound_reason: An operation on the catalog, not a data producer: it writes no lakehouse table, so a finished run prints `foundation-job-outcome unchanged` (scripts/deploy/datahub-runtime.sh). That it keeps finishing is the done bound.
